# Original synthetic hardware session

`hardware-session.usb9.synthetic.json` is generated by
`node scripts/hardware-session.js` using the production PC projector.
It contains Elian, original invented test powers, resources and coin counts.
No personal character, Beyond response, external catalogue or credentials.

`node scripts/hardware-session.js --check` checks the committed file against
the projector and sends it through the actual native C packet parser. All
30 check bonuses are compared with the PC calculation. It runs in the host
firmware suite; it does not open serial ports or any browser collection.

Physical setup and expected session outcomes: `docs/PRIMO-AVVIO.md`.
